title: OFFICE KEEPER
description:
Game OverviewBite-sized, score-attack horror cleaning game. Each shift lasts just 5 to 10 minutes.

After each successful run, you'll return to the title screen to start your next shift. 

Online score uploads are supported, allowing you to compete with other cleaners.

You are assigned to just one single building—but this cleaning shift is anything but ordinary.

Switch between a vacuum and a cloth to eliminate filth, racking up high scores and EXP.

Evade the mysterious "Entity" stalking the halls, hit the target score, and clock out safely through the main entrance to complete the day's work.

The Assignment: A Rather "Complicated" PropertyAccording to the employer, Mr. Brian, every previous cleaner was chased out by "something" inside, leaving the job half-done. 

“And that’s where you come in!” 

Thrown straight into the deep end, can a single cleaner survive the shift and get the job done?

Key Features• Intuitive Cleaning Action: Satisfyingly realistic mechanics where dust and stains vanish exactly where wiped or vacuumed.

• Randomized Layouts for High Replayability: Filth and dust change locations every single run. Even with one map, every shift delivers fresh tension for the score attack.

• Resource Management: Flashlight batteries and speed-boosting sprays drain with use. Scavenge through drawers and shelves to find replacements and refills.

• Gear Upgrades: Level up equipment by earning EXP. Better tools mean higher cleaning efficiency and increased score multipliers.

• Tense Horror Atmosphere: The "Someone" wandering the halls hunts based on sound. Getting caught means an immediate Game Over. True completion requires securing a high score and escaping through the main entrance.

• Online Score Uploads Supported: Upload high scores directly to the online leaderboard to compete with other cleaners.

Pro-Tips for a Perfect ShiftScores grow slowly at first. 

Collect "Belongings" and "Vestiges" or level up gear to unlock massive score bonuses.

• Belongings (Permanent Shift Multiplier): Each item recovered grants a permanent score multiplier for the remainder of that shift (up to 2.0x).

• Vestiges (Temporary Boost): Touch the spirits of past cleaners ruthlessly chased away. These remnants inspire action, granting a temporary score multiplier (up to 1.3x) and restoring stamina.

• Check the Drawers: When the flashlight dies, rifle through drawers and shelves for spare batteries.

• Manage the Lights: Turning on building lights saves flashlight power. Better yet, switching them back OFF before leaving rewards a bonus on the final report.

• Hunt Rare Targets: Spotting "Colorful Dust" or "Mysterious Stains" is a stroke of luck. Cleaning them yields massive score and EXP bonuses. (Listen closely—an announcement triggers when they appear or vanish).

• Speed is Life: As time ticks away, the "Entity" moves faster. Making noise draws it directly to the source. Since working silently is impossible, the only option is to move fast, clean fast, and get out!

 Development Tools ・ Game Engine - Unity 

・ Music - Studio One 

・ 3D Modeling, Rigging - Blender 

・ Motion - Cascadeur, Blender 

・ Illustration - Clip Studio Paint 

・ Programming (First Half of Development) - Sublime Text 

・ Video Editing - DaVinci Resolve

 AI Usage in Development ・Programming (Latter Half of Development) 

・A portion of interior textures (book covers and paintings)

Streaming & Content Creation Policy You are free to stream, create videos, and monetize content of this game on platforms like YouTube, Twitch, etc., whether you are an individual or an organization. No prior permission is required.
description_short: 5-to-10-minute score-attack cleaning with a spooky twist. Clean an abandoned office while evading a creepy "Entity." Vacuum and wipe away randomized dust, watching filth vanish right where it's traced. Secure the target score and report back to finish the shift!
